name: Emoji picker
description: Insert standard Unicode emoji with local search, variants, favorites, and optional shortcode suggestions.

autocomplete.title: Shortcode suggestions
autocomplete.description: Offer local emoji suggestions while typing a colon shortcode in an editable note.

recents.title: Recent emoji
recents.description: Local recent selections, maintained by Denote as a JSON array. Set to [] to clear.

favorites.title: Favorite emoji
favorites.description: Local favorites, maintained by Denote as a JSON array. Set to [] to clear.

tone.title: Preferred skin tone
tone.description: 0 uses the default emoji; 1–5 select light through dark skin tones where available.
